description:
ArmCompileState owns questions: Vec<RegionQuestion>. src/dispatch_matrix/mod.rs:857 clones every arm's questions to start, and :897 copies arm.questions[1..].to_vec() for every arm at every shared prefix, so the copying is quadratic in prefix depth.
Shape: questions: &[RegionQuestion], stripped by reslicing. The first_question cloned at :882 is stored by the test node and stays.
Heat: per shared prefix and per arm in compile_arm_sequence, for every clause set compiled.

Method: .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md. Change the signature and let cargo check enumerate dependents; resolve interleavings by compute-then-commit or a split borrow; stop and report if an Rc is the only move.
Signal: pure refactor. Full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves. Report the clone/to_vec count of each touched file before and after.
Sites were read at develop 8bf8775ae and not compiled; confirm each with cargo check before relying on it.
